name: Lucy
tagline: First mission to the Jupiter Trojans
description: NASA's 12-year multi-flyby mission to 6 Jupiter Trojan asteroid systems and 2 main-belt asteroids (11 total encounters including satellites). Three Earth gravity assists shape a single trajectory visiting both the L4 and L5 Trojan clouds. Carries 1003 kg of hydrazine — more propellant than dry mass. Named for the 1974 Australopithecus afarensis fossil, in turn named for the Beatles song — the implication being that Trojans preserve early-solar-system material the way the fossil preserves early-human history.
best_known_for: First mission to the Jupiter Trojans
